title: Data Analyst
description: Transforms raw business and transactional data into actionable operational insights, automated reports, and strategic intelligence.

title: Business Analyst
description: Bridges the gap between IT and business stakeholders using data analysis, requirements elicitation, and process modeling.

title: Product Analyst
description: Analyzes user journeys, conversion funnels, retention metrics, and A/B experiments to guide product roadmaps.

title: Software Developer
description: Designs, develops, tests, and maintains modern web and distributed backend software applications.

title: Data Scientist
description: Builds statistical models, machine learning algorithms, and predictive systems to solve complex business challenges.

title: AI/ML Engineer
description: Deploys, monitors, and optimizes scalable machine learning pipelines, LLM architectures, and inference microservices.

title: Cloud Engineer
description: Architects, provisions, and secures scalable cloud infrastructure and CI/CD automation across GCP, AWS, or Azure.

title: Generative AI Specialist
description: Designs multi-agent systems, RAG architectures, prompt pipelines, and fine-tunes LLMs for enterprise automation.

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
description: Protects organizational data and networks through vulnerability management, threat hunting, and incident response.
